notes.title: 🐟🏪Aquatic Store Simulator Full Release🏪🐟
notes.notes:
Hello gamers

We have just launched  🐟🏪Aquatic Store Simulator🏪🐟

[previewyoutube=PsUPMKioYPA;full][/previewyoutube]

It is a casual and relaxing "supermarket" simulation game where you 

Take on the challenge of managing your underwater-themed supermarket, blending business management with the beauty of marine life. Stock shelves with exotic fish🐙, decorations🖼️, set prices💲, take payments💰 and more!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3073580/Aquatic_Store_Simulator/


You can buy the game even cheaper in a bundle. Check it out:

Have a great time playing,
FreeMind team.

notes.title: Arena Renovator full release!
notes.notes:
Hello Arena Renovators!
The day has come! 🏆🏆🏆

[previewyoutube=XCQ65yTU274;full][/previewyoutube]

Today is our BIG DAY we've been waiting for! - full release of Arena Renovation!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33646252/355e2c7f3a5da74be9cbb1e6a4065197528039c8.png

https://store.steampowered.com/app/948880/Arena_Renovation/

Despite many difficulties and challenges - here we are and you are the ones we are very grateful for. Thanks to your support, reviews, information you provided, we've been able to make it to this very moment! ːsteamhappyː 🏆

To celebrate the premiere, we have a surprise for you and it is BIG, a football stadium!


 football stadium is yours to run! Good luck! ⚽💪🏻
we have a completely new scale of activities! You'll find your way around the mechanics easily, but everything is just BIGGER
many new types of rooms: VIP, Conference, Lectures, Restaurant
many bug fixes!
